data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's mechanism asserts the checklist 'eliminates omission errors' and shifts failure from omission to commission. But the problem asks to 'identify what evidence within a single evaluation would distinguish a genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer.' SRC_002 never identifies any such distinguishing evidence. Its counterconditions name cases where the panel might fail (non-decomposable tasks, compliance fatigue, baseline literacy), but none of these are evidence observable within an evaluation that distinguishes genuine reliability from coincidental compliance. It answers the first half of the problem but omits the second required component: the evidentiary discriminator.
